drafts.subject: Smith Point Capital — NetBox Labs
drafts.body:
Hi Kristopher,

I've been keeping a close eye on NetBox Labs — just caught your recent update (“Multi-Vendor by Design: Seven New Integrations for the Stack You Actually Run”). Would love to grab ~20 minutes to compare notes — no agenda, just have a hunch there could be a fit. Lmk if useful.

Best,
Lilly

Hi there,

I'm Lilly, an investor at Smith Point Capital — an enterprise software fund co-founded by Keith Block, former co-CEO of Salesforce, alongside Burke Norton (formerly Salesforce, Vista) and Chris Lytle (formerly Morgan Stanley).

Congrats on the recent Series A ($14M). We like getting to know founders early and building relationships well before a round comes together — no agenda, and totally understand if you're heads-down right now. We partner with founders who want more than capital — an operator-led approach backed by a team with deep experience scaling mission-critical platforms across Salesforce, ServiceNow, Cisco, Databricks, and Oracle.

On the "more than capital" front: we can open doors with the health systems and enterprise buyers you're selling into, help accelerate those sales motions, and work closely with founders on GTM strategy, enterprise pricing, and building out leadership teams.

We've been spending time in this space, and Healia Health (YC W24) stands out:
- You're building healthcare & bio AI — exactly the kind of deeply embedded, mission-critical software we like to back.
- Momentum is real — your recent Series A ($14M) signals genuine enterprise pull.

Would you be open to a brief intro call? Would love to hear more about Healia Health (YC W24) and share more about Smith Point. Please lmk what works in the coming weeks!

Best,
Lilly
drafts.based_on: Congrats on the recent Series A ($14M).
